figures.finding: Stage actors in Finland work under the generally applicable Actors' Theatre Collective Agreement 2025-2028, signed by Suomen Teatterit (the theatres' employers) and Näyttelijäliitto (the Finnish Actors' Union), running from 2 April 2025 to 29 February 2028.
figures.applies: Finland, professional theatres, actors on monthly pay and visiting actors, 2025-04-02 to 2028-02-29.

sources.said: NÄYTTELIJÖIDEN TEATTERITYÖEHTOSOPIMUS 2025-2028 Suomen Teatterit - Finlands Teatrar ry … Näyttelijäliitto - Skådespelarförbundet ry … Sopimuskausi alkaa 2.4.2025 ja päättyy 29.2.2028.

figures.finding: The agreement's minimum basic monthly pay for a theatre actor is €2,552.52, rising to €2,616.33 from 1 August 2025, €2,692.20 from 1 June 2026 and €2,756.81 from 1 June 2027; regular working time is at most 7.5 hours a day.
figures.applies: Finland, theatres under the agreement, actors on monthly pay.

sources.said: 1. Näyttelijän vähimmäisperuspalkka on 2552,52 euroa, 1.8.2025 lukien 2616,33 euroa ja 1.6.2026 lukien 2692,20 euroa sekä 1.6.2027 lukien 2756,81 euroa. … 2. Näyttelijän säännöllinen työaika on enintään 7,5 tuntia päivässä.

figures.finding: A visiting (guest) actor's minimum fee per performance is €205.55 for an A role and €171.88 for a B role, rising in three steps to €222.00 and €185.64 from 1 June 2027; a rehearsal pays 50% of the agreed performance fee, and a performance fee covers at most 4 hours.
figures.applies: Finland, theatres under the agreement, visiting actors on fixed-term contracts (Annexes 1 and 2).

sources.said: LIITE 2: VIERAILUSOPIMUKSEN VÄHIMMÄISPALKKIOT Palkkiot Palkkiot 1.8.2025 lukien 1.6.2026 lukien 1.6.2027 lukien A-rooli 205,55 euroa 210,69 euroa 216,80 euroa 222,00 euroa B-rooli 171,88 euroa 176,18 euroa 181,29 euroa 185,64 euroa … Harjoituksesta maksetaan 50 % sovitusta esityspalkkiosta. Palkkiot sisältävät esityskohtaisena työaikana korkeintaan 4 tuntia

figures.finding: No collective agreement sets a film or television actor's pay in Finland: the union and the service-sector employers (Palta) publish only a non-binding model employment contract for film and TV actors.

value.modelContract: Palta ry and Näyttelijäliitto joint recommendation (non-binding)

figures.applies: Finland, actors in film and TV productions, as of 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Palvelualojen työnantajat Palta ry ja Näyttelijäliitto – Skådespelarförbundet ry ovat laatineet yhteisen suosituksen mallityösopimuspohjasta ja sitä koskevasta ohjeistuksesta. figures.finding: The Finnish Actors' Union (Näyttelijäliitto, founded 1913) represents 96% of actors; full membership needs either 160 credits (three years) of higher-education actor training or two years' professional work counted at €27,000 a year; dues are 1.6% of income (freelancers €324 to €708 a year in 2026, capped at income of €44,250).

join: 160 ECTS / 3 years' actor training at an approved school
or 2 years' professional work, a year counted as €27,000 of pay at least at agreement rates

sources.said: Established in 1913, the union is the oldest theatre trade union in Finland. The vast majority (96%) of actors are part of the union.
